English.curriculum: Norton University's English programs prepare students for ASEAN integration with comprehensive language training and specialized career paths. Program features: international faculty from multiple countries, focus on fluent English communication and specific professional skills to dominate regional workplaces, extra-curricular activities including English competitions, workshops with students from Australia, Japan, and Singapore, internship programs, study tours, and community service. Three specialized Bachelor of Arts programs: 1) B.A. in English for International Relations & Diplomacy (EIRD) - focuses on international security, political economy, diplomatic work, and negotiations; 2) B.A. in English for Business Affairs (EBA) - emphasizes report writing, presentations, marketing, negotiation, cross-cultural communication, and international business; 3) B.A. in English for Educational Management & Teaching (EMT) - covers teaching approaches, classroom observation, practice teaching, and school management. Career opportunities include diplomatic corps, international organizations, multinational corporations, NGOs, educational institutions, and regional business sectors.

Medicine.university: Norton University - Faculty of Health Sciences (FHS)
Medicine.curriculum: Norton University offers Doctor of Medicine (M.D.) program providing comprehensive medical education in General Medicine. The program focuses on medical practice and treatment with general characteristics for patients of all ages, including health education, disease prevention, control and monitoring of disease progression to improve human health. General Medicine practitioners treat acute and chronic illnesses and provide preventive care and health education to patients. The 8-year program prepares students to become general medical practitioners (not specialized doctors). Curriculum includes basic medical sciences, clinical rotations, patient care, diagnostic procedures, treatment protocols, and medical ethics. Students gain hands-on experience in hospitals and clinical settings under supervision of experienced physicians.
Medicine.location: St. Keo Chenda, Chroy Changvar, Phnom Penh

Dentistry.university: Norton University - Faculty of Health Sciences (FHS)
Dentistry.curriculum: Norton University offers Doctor of Dentistry (D.D.S.) program, also known as Dental Medicine and Oral Medicine. Dentistry is a branch of medicine focused on the study of teeth, gingiva (gums), and oral cavity. The program consists of comprehensive training in study, diagnosis, prevention, management, and treatment of diseases, disorders, and conditions of the oral cavity, most commonly focused on the pathology of teeth and oral mucosa. Dentistry also encompasses other aspects of diseases, disorders, and conditions of the face and craniofacial complex, including the temporomandibular joint. The 7-year program includes theoretical studies in dental sciences, laboratory work, clinical practice, patient treatment, and specialized procedures in oral surgery, orthodontics, periodontics, endodontics, and prosthodontics.
Dentistry.location: St. Keo Chenda, Chroy Changvar, Phnom Penh

Pharmacy.university: Norton University - Faculty of Health Sciences (FHS)
Pharmacy.curriculum: Norton University offers Bachelor of Pharmacy program for students who want to become pharmacists (also known as druggists or chemists). Pharmacy is a health care profession focusing on safe and effective medicine use. The program covers pharmaceutical sciences, focusing on the efficacy and safety of medication use. Students learn about different types of drugs including chemical substances, microbiological products, and herbal mixtures used in prevention and treatment of human and animal diseases, medical research, diagnosis, modification, and maintenance of organ functions. The 5-year curriculum includes pharmaceutical chemistry, pharmacology, pharmaceutics, medicinal chemistry, pharmacy practice, clinical pharmacy, drug interactions, medication therapy management, and patient counseling. Graduates work in community pharmacies, hospitals, pharmaceutical companies, research institutions, and regulatory agencies.
Pharmacy.location: St. Keo Chenda, Chroy Changvar, Phnom Penh

Nursing.university: Norton University - Faculty of Health Sciences (FHS) - Bachelor Degree
Nursing.curriculum: Norton University offers Bachelor of Nursing program, a profession within the health care sector focused on the care of individuals, families, and communities to help them attain, maintain, or recover optimal health and quality of life. The program is designed in accordance with the core competency framework for Cambodian professional nurses and the practice standards of Cambodian nurses. The 4-year curriculum includes nursing fundamentals, anatomy and physiology, medical-surgical nursing, pediatric nursing, maternal and child health, community health nursing, mental health nursing, nursing research, and clinical practice in various healthcare settings. Students develop skills in patient assessment, care planning, medication administration, health promotion, and therapeutic communication. Graduates work in hospitals, clinics, community health centers, schools, and other healthcare facilities.
Nursing.location: St. Keo Chenda, Chroy Changvar, Phnom Penh

Nursing.university: Norton University - Faculty of Health Sciences (FHS) - Associate Degree
Nursing.curriculum: Norton University offers Associate Degree in Nursing, a 3-year program within the health care sector focused on the care of individuals, families, and communities. Students learn to provide care so that patients may attain, maintain, or recover optimal health and quality of life through treatment and health recovery. The associate degree program provides foundational nursing education including basic nursing skills, patient care, health assessment, medication administration, and clinical practice. This program prepares students for entry-level nursing positions and provides a pathway to advance to the Bachelor of Nursing program. Graduates can work as registered nurses in hospitals, clinics, and community health settings under appropriate supervision.
Nursing.location: St. Keo Chenda, Chroy Changvar, Phnom Penh

Midwifery.university: Norton University - Faculty of Health Sciences (FHS) - Bachelor Degree
Midwifery.curriculum: Norton University offers Bachelor of Midwifery program, a health care profession in which providers offer specialized care to childbearing women. Midwives are specialists in providing care to women during pregnancy, labor and birth, and during the postpartum period, with the goal of improving the quality of life for mothers and babies. The 4-year program includes comprehensive training in prenatal care, labor and delivery management, postpartum care, newborn care, women's health, reproductive health, family planning, high-risk pregnancy management, and emergency obstetric care. Students gain extensive clinical experience in maternity wards, delivery rooms, and community health settings. Graduates work in hospitals, birthing centers, community health programs, and maternal-child health services.
Midwifery.location: St. Keo Chenda, Chroy Changvar, Phnom Penh

Midwifery.university: Norton University - Faculty of Health Sciences (FHS) - Associate Degree
Midwifery.curriculum: Norton University offers Associate Degree in Midwifery, a 3-year health care profession program for providers who offer care to childbearing women during pregnancy, labor and birth, and during the postpartum period. The program focuses on improving the quality of life for mothers and babies. Students learn essential midwifery skills including prenatal assessment, normal delivery assistance, postpartum care, newborn care, and maternal health education. The associate degree provides foundational midwifery education and prepares graduates for entry-level midwifery positions in hospitals, health centers, and community maternal health programs. Graduates can also continue to the Bachelor of Midwifery program for advanced training.
Midwifery.location: St. Keo Chenda, Chroy Changvar, Phnom Penh

Medical Laboratory Technology.university: Norton University - Faculty of Health Sciences (FHS)
Medical Laboratory Technology.curriculum: Norton University offers Associate Degree in Medical Laboratory Technology for students who want to become laboratory technicians. A laboratory technician is a person who, under the supervision of a medical technologist or physician, performs microscopic and bacteriologic tests of human blood, tissue, and fluids for diagnostic and research purposes. The program focuses on medical laboratory sciences, specializing in analysis of blood, tissues, various fluids and components in the body through research and examination to detect pathogens and assist in accurate diagnosis. The 3-year curriculum includes clinical chemistry, hematology, microbiology, immunology, blood banking, parasitology, laboratory equipment operation, quality control, safety procedures, and extensive hands-on laboratory practice. Graduates work in hospital laboratories, diagnostic centers, research facilities, and public health laboratories supporting physicians in disease diagnosis and patient care.
Medical Laboratory Technology.location: St. Keo Chenda, Chroy Changvar, Phnom Penh

Korean.university: Royal University of Phnom Penh - Institute of Foreign Languages
Korean.curriculum: B.A. Course: Year 2 begins formal study of Korean language from beginner to low-intermediate; develops grammar, speaking, listening, reading, writing and cultural understanding. Key modules: Grammar I–II; Speaking I–II; Listening I–II; Reading I–II; Composition I–II; Speech I–II; Introduction to Korean Society & Culture. Year 3 focuses on intermediate skills (Grammar III–IV, Speaking III–IV, Listening III–IV, Reading III–IV, Composition III–IV, Speech III–IV), Ancient & Modern History of Korea, Chinese Characters in Korean I–II. Year 4 includes Academic Korean, Korean for Mass Communication I–II, Presentation & Discussion, Linguistics, Korean Literature, Teaching Methodology, Business Korean I, Translation, Practicum, and Academic Writing for Thesis.
